name: Petrarch
contribution: An Italian scholar and poet of the early Italian Renaissance, as well as one of the earliest Renaissance humanists.

checks.lead: Francis Petrarch (born Francesco di Petracco; 20 July 1304 – 19 July 1374) was an Italian scholar and poet of the early Italian Renaissance, as well as one of the earliest Renaissance humanists.
